title: iris longifolia
intro: Iris longifolia, commonly known as the crested iris, is a flowering plant species in the iris family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Iris longifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which help to relieve coughs, ease pain, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Iris longifolia include flavonoids, glycosides, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
